steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each step depends on the one before it. A step that is not listed breaks the chain.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Database change with no reverse step
Cache step has no verification
findings.fix: Add a check that the cache is cleared

findings.title: Notify step depends on a step not listed
findings.fix: List the step it depends on

outcome.notChecked: Whether the rollback works in production.
